fusions.name: Rib-Cracker Embrace
fusions.desc: A crushing hug that deals 30 damage, ignores the target's armour, and leaves it 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Wounded Thrash
fusions.desc: Costs 4% of your maximum health. You thrash at every enemy within 2.5 tiles for 7 damage, rising 8% for every tenth of your health already lost, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Shake It Off
fusions.desc: Restores 16 health to you, rising 8% for every tenth of your health already lost, up to 40%. The heal has a 10% chance to crit.

fusions.name: Mounting Heft
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. At 8 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 7% of your maximum health per stack (56% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
